newsitem.title: SYRIA: Syria offers 100,000 tonnes of wheat for sale.
newsitem.headline: Syria offers 100,000 tonnes of wheat for sale.

text.p: Syria's General Establishment For Cereal Processing And Trade (GECPT) has offered 100,000 tonnes of hard amber durum wheat for sale, a company spokesman said on Sunday.
He said an international call for prices setting November 26 as final date to receive price offers had already been issued. Confirmation would be made on November 27.
The amount would be ready for shipment in January 1997, he added.
He said partial offer would be accepted, but not less than 5,000 tonnes and the GECPT has the right to confirm for bidders.
